description: This file defines a composable toggle button component called NiaIconToggleButton for Android using Jetpack Compose. It wraps Material 3's FilledIconToggleButton, adding custom styling, defaults, and previews. It also contains theme and preview setup functions, along with constants related to icon button appearance.

classes.name: NiaIconButtonDefaults
classes.description: Object holding default constants for NiaIconToggleButton, including transparency for disabled container

methods.name: NiaIconToggleButton
methods.description: A custom toggle button with icon support, wrapping Material 3's FilledIconToggleButton, with configurable checked state, icons, and styling

methods.name: IconButtonPreview
methods.description: Preview composable demonstrating the toggle button in a checked state

methods.name: IconButtonPreviewUnchecked
methods.description: Preview composable demonstrating the toggle button in an unchecked state
